_comment: pecli ligandmpnn config for the specificity-block RESAMPLE. Same NA-aware inverse folding as the binder block, but deeper sampling (100 sequences/backbone vs 5) to find the specificity-optimal sequence on a backbone that already passed the binder block. Paper: temperature 0.1, 100 seq/backbone. Only binder-block passers with minPAE < 1.25 enter here.
_total_sequences: batch_size * number_of_batches = 100 per backbone (paper scale). For a smoke test reduce to e.g. 10.
_chains_to_design: The DESIGNED PROTEIN chain only -- never the DNA chains, which are fixed context. 'C' was READ OFF a real relaxed rfd3na backbone, not assumed: rfd3na emits the fixed target duplex first, so the relaxed PDB is DNA A(12 nt) + DNA B(12 nt) + protein C(123 aa). Note this is the OPPOSITE of the refold's layout (protein A + DNA B,C from build_fold_inputs.py) -- that very mismatch caused the Stage-7 RMSD bug where protein Ca found zero overlap and the DNA matched the wrong strand. This field was the literal placeholder 'SET_FROM_RFD3NA_OUTPUT' until 2026-08-06. Re-read the chain layout from the relaxed PDB if the diffusion spec's contig order ever changes; do not carry 'C' forward on faith.
_entry_gate: Only backbones from binder-block passers with on-target minPAE < 1.25 are resampled here (paper). Enforce upstream when building the resample worklist.
